I haven't experienced any irritation, which is a huge plus for someone who usually finds "retinol-like" products a bit harsh. As far as my skin tone is concerned, the Niacinamide is definitely doing its job. My skin tone looks much more even, and I've noticed a significant boost in overall radiance and "glow." My pores also look slightly more refined. The reason I'm giving this 4 stars instead of 5 is that I haven't seen a visible difference in my fine lines or wrinkles yet. My skin definitely feels firmer and "plumper" because of the moisture, but the actual depth of my fine lines remains the same for now considering I've only been using this for such a short time frame.
